kind: dry run; nothing written to production

pointssummary.rule: DENSE rank on exact points_total / ppg within (season, positional_grouping); population = every player in src_pointssummary that season; no games minimum; weeks = 1 .. last UPS week (playoffs included)

alltime_rank_proposal.definition: completed seasons 2011-2025; PPG = all MFL points over every UPS week / weeks with a posted score; eligible when weeks scored >= ceil(0.75 x the season's UPS weeks) (12 of 16, 13 of 17); competition rank within src_weekly pos_group; top 100 shown
